---
title: "Emacs"
---

The following is a quick starter guide designed to get you acquainted with Emacs, a desktop application for editing $\LaTeX$. Of our recommended applications, Emacs is the most powerful in terms of text editing and customization.

These instructions are for macOS. The installers, the Homebrew steps, and the keyboard shortcuts all assume it; Emacs itself runs on Windows and Linux, and the IQSS configuration works there, but the steps in this guide are written for a Mac.
